description_en: Queries the URL of the web UI for a Spark application
kebab_example: aliyun adb get-spark-app-web-ui-address --app-id s202205201533hz12098920000000 --db-cluster-id amv-uf6g8w25jacm70000 --api-version 2021-12-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetSparkAppWebUiAddress
